title: Why Does a Week Have Seven Days?
hook: A year doesn't divide evenly by seven. Neither do most months. So why is your week seven days?

segments.n: Others tried to change it. Revolutionary France tested a ten-day week, and the Soviet Union tried shorter ones. Neither lasted.

segments.n: The week survives because we agreed on it, not because of math. What else do we follow just because everyone does?
